name: Payments Fraud Scoring & Investigation
description: Agent-native payments fraud platform: real-time transaction scoring, natural-language case investigation (smurfing, velocity, mule networks), and FinCEN-structured SAR drafting. A supervisor agent delegates to three specialists on Bedrock AgentCore using the Strands SDK, with Cognito auth and Langfuse observability.

frameworks.name: Strands Agents SDK
frameworks.description: Supervisor + 3 specialist agents (scorer, investigator, SAR) on Bedrock AgentCore

deployment_patterns.name: Terraform
deployment_patterns.description: Composes the AVA control-plane templates: agent-runtime-agentcore, auth-cognito, agent-observability

example_use_cases: Real-time payment fraud scoring (approve / step-up / hold-and-case)
Natural-language investigation of smurfing, velocity, and mule-network patterns
FinCEN-structured Suspicious Activity Report drafting with human-in-the-loop review
author: AVA Team
